verdict.rationale: GA4 documents the Data API for programmatic analytical queries, with filters, pagination, batch pivot, realtime and funnel reports, plus client libraries and a Query Explorer. It also documents export of all raw events to BigQuery, where they can be queried with SQL, on a daily full export plus continuous intraday exports. A community member corroborates that GA4 hooks into BigQuery easily. Missing for 10: raw event-level data is only reachable through the BigQuery export, since the Data API returns aggregated reports; there is no hands-on corroboration of the Data API's depth; and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found.
